description: Shared, language-neutral triage test table (rules 0.2.0, ADR 014). Run by pytest (backend/triage) and Jest (app). Expected values were authored by the engineering team and are NOT clinically graded.
graded_by_drg_note: No case is graded by a dentist yet (graded_by_drg=false for all). The >= 30 dentist-graded cases requirement is NOT met; no clinical claim may be made.
how_to_run: For each case: params = resolve_params(rules, profiles[input.params_profile].values); call evaluate(rules, input without params_profile, params); compare expected.level, reasons ids (ordered), advice_ids (ordered), referral_template_id, and expected.lesions (listed keys only), or expect a TriageInputError with expected.error_code.
